thread:
mira: Found an old S3 backup artifact containing a Vault-wrapped ciphertext that unwraps with our backup CMK. not sure if exfil, treating as incident. starting containment and coordination.
jon: on it. object path? i'll pull access logs and kms decrypt attempts.
mira: s3://redwood-archive/backups/2024-08-01/agent_state.blob
mira: immediate asks: revoke CMK alias, create replacement key, and rotate Vault transit key used for backups to limit blast radius.
tasha: agree. also add SIEM alert for any Decrypt or GetObject on that path, and forward Vault audit stream for transit/decrypt calls.
ops-oncall: frozen writes to that prefix, enabling object-level logging to secure-audit bucket for 72h.
jon: initial access log grep: 4 GETs in last 10 days from ci-runner-17 and one from partner-ingest-role. starting identity churn.
sec-bot: playbook match: "keystore-evict". recommended steps: key revoke, rewrap, service-account rotation, audit-forwarder.
mira: proposed action list:
1) revoke old CMK alias and create new key (alias redwood/backups)
2) create new Vault transit key and rewrap ciphertexts
3) rotate IAM roles/keys for ci-runner-17 and partner-ingest-role
4) enable vault audit forwarding + SIEM rules for decrypts
jon: opening infra PR to rotate CMK and create new alias. link when ready. this will schedule a short wallet window for restores.
jon: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/834 
mira: tasha, can you own Vault rewrap and policy tighten? need partner entitlement removed from transit key.
tasha: taking it. plan: create backup-v2 transit key, run transit/rewrap for artifacts, and remove grant for partner-ingest via ACL change. example: 
```
# create new transit key
vault write -f transit/keys/backup-v2
# rewrap ciphertext
vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@agent_state.blob key=backup-v2
```
jon: note: rotating ci-runner role will cause CI downtime. ops-oncall, schedule a 30m maintenance and put notify in #deployments.
ops-oncall: scheduled 23:30 UTC 30m maintenance. posting notice and rollback play ready.
mira: enabling high-priority tag on Vault audit stream so SOC gets immediate notifications for transit/decrypt events.
tasha: adding an event hook to auto-create a ticket if decrypt is called by non-admin identity.
sec-bot: checklist update: CMK revoke: started; Vault transit key: creation pending; service account rotation: pending; SIEM alerts: in-progress.
jon: found obsolete CI token in artifact metadata; rotating all CI tokens issued before 2025-01-01 as precaution. starting churn for pool.
tasha: will publish impacted jobs matrix and coordinate owners.
ops-oncall: tested restore with new key on a sample artifact; restore path works. holding old alias disabled until SOC clearance.
mira: drafting customer-facing message: "We identified a retained backup containing encrypted data. Keys have been rotated and access controls tightened. No evidence of customer data exfiltration so far." saving to incident-docs.
jon: infra PR merged; CI roles rotated; pipelines rekeyed.
tasha: vault rewrap completed for affected blobs; partner-ingest grant removed; audit hook live.
ops-oncall: CMK alias rotated and old key scheduled for destruction after 30 days (per retention policy).
sec-bot: queued follow-ups: full RBAC audit, KMS policy hardening, SIEM rule tuning, postmortem.
mira: thanks everyone. mark complete in this thread when your items are done. i'll run a post-incident RBAC sweep next week and file remediation tickets. :thumbsup:
